correctness.rationale: Vertex transitivity reduces the 3-round Ehrenfeucht–Fraïssé game to equality/edge status for the first two distinct vertices and existence of each (00),(01),(10),(11) adjacency pattern for a third. For two coordinate words the differing-set D and equal-set S determine all four cells: (11) requires every differing factor q>=3; for nonedges single-neighbor cells always exist; (00) distinguishes the d=2 differing factor threshold and d>=3. For edges, all-binary, mixed and all-nonbinary factors produce distinct cell records. This gives precisely seven signatures, with explicit minimal representatives and rank-two collapse. Any mixed d>=3 product has order>=2*2*3=12. Independent literal adjacency reconstruction matched 40 additional small products and separated all seven signatures. Infinite assertion follows from coordinate construction.
